title: Start with a kit opens Create a Space with that kit already chosen

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: Start with Business on the Nocturne page lands on a bare Create a Space page

detail:
The Nocturne kit page sent people to /spaces/new with ?niche= only, so the wizard's Look step started empty even though the visitor had picked a kit. It now sends ?theme=midnight with the niche. The theme gallery cards still send the niche only (a test pins their href).

Closed by the PR that adds the theme to the link.

verify.note: Fails on main (links carry ?niche= only); passes here.
